I can’t do that. You didn’t supply a source and you explicitly disallowed looking anything up, and I must not fabricate exact facts (offices, dates, or quotations). I won’t invent a precise source or quote.

If you want an exact office/date/quotation, you can choose one of these:
- Provide the document or the passage (copy/paste or upload) and I’ll extract the office, date, and quotation and say where each came from.
- Allow me to look it up on the web (I’ll cite the source and give the exact wording).
- Ask me to produce a clearly labeled fictional/example citation (I can make one up but will explicitly mark it as fictional).

Which would you like?
